notes: One entry per kind of thing. The key is its id, used in level files.
name, text: shown to the player. Keep them plain.
weight: kilograms. size: 1 small, 2 medium, 3 large. floor: how big its picture is on the ground, in metres (for long things).
holds + maxSize: it is a container with that many places, taking things up to that size.
wear: where it is worn ('back': a knapsack; 'body' or 'head': armour). armour: the share of every blow it takes while worn (body and head add up, to 0.6 at most).
level (a weapon): the level it starts at (1 if not given). Each level above 1 adds 40% of its damage. whet: a whetstone (using it raises the level of the weapon in your hand).
icon: stand-in picture: colour and shape (disc, box, bag, stick, bottle, ring, tool).
worth: what it is worth in a trade (src/shop.js). Things with no worth cannot be traded.
weapon: it can be fought with while in a hand. damage; type = cut, stab or crush; thrust = the type a low thrust does, if different;
reach in metres; wind = seconds to wind up a full blow; recover = seconds before the next blow.
block: the part of a blow it stops when you block with it (0.8 = 80%).
food: how much hunger it takes away (the food bar is 0 to 100). heal: health given back when eaten.
drinks: how many drinks it holds. count: how many are in it (matches).
light: it can be lit. power and range of the light; burn = seconds a full one lasts; start = seconds in it when found;
fuel = what fills it (paraffin or oil); flicker:true = unsteady; once:true = it burns away and is gone.
fuel: it fills a light that burns this (paraffin or oil). sleep: it lets you sleep.
potion: a drink that is used up. heal = health given back. map: it is the notebook the map is drawn in.
Things with none of these numbers are useless: bones, broken pots, rags. Most of what lies in a tomb is like that.
Pictures: art/items/<id>.png (made in Blender, see tools/blender). The icon colour and shape is only a stand-in for a thing with no picture.

knapsack.name: Knapsack
knapsack.text: A canvas dig knapsack. Worn on your back. Holds 12 things.

pouch.name: Leather pouch
pouch.text: A small pouch. Holds 4 small things.

match_bundle.name: Bundle of matches
match_bundle.text: A tied bundle of matches. It fills your box of matches again.

pocket_knife.name: Pocket knife
pocket_knife.text: A small folding knife. A poor weapon.

notebook.name: Notebook
notebook.text: Your notebook and pencil. Your map is drawn in it.

bully_beef.name: Tin of beef
bully_beef.text: Tinned beef from the dig's stores. Food.

dates.name: Dried dates
dates.text: A handful of dried dates. Food.

canteen.name: Canteen
canteen.text: A metal water bottle. A drink gives back stamina. Fill it at water.

pick.name: Pick
pick.text: A digging pick. Heavy and slow, but it hits hard.

dagger.name: Bronze dagger
dagger.text: An old bronze dagger, green with age. Quick.

oil_lamp.name: Clay lamp
oil_lamp.text: A small clay oil lamp. A weak light. It fits on your belt.

lapis_amulet.name: Lapis amulet
lapis_amulet.text: An amulet of blue stone. Treasure.

gold_cup.name: Gold cup
gold_cup.text: A small cup made of gold. Treasure.

lantern.name: Paraffin lantern
lantern.text: The dig's paraffin lantern. A bright, steady light. Carry it in a hand.

torch.name: Old torch
torch.text: Reeds dipped in pitch. A bright light, but it burns away. Carry it in a hand. Lit, it sets the dead alight.

honey.name: Jar of honey
honey.text: Honey from a tomb. It never goes bad. Food.

bedroll.name: Bedroll
bedroll.text: A canvas bedroll from the dig. You need it to sleep.

spear.name: Old spear
spear.text: A long spear with a bronze point. It reaches far.

club.name: Club
club.text: A heavy wooden club. It breaks bone.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.text: A claw hammer with a wooden handle. Small and quick. It breaks bone.

mace.name: Stone mace
mace.text: A wooden club with a stone head. Good against bone.

curved_sword.name: Curved sword
curved_sword.text: A curved bronze sword. It cuts well.

shield.name: Wooden shield
shield.text: A wooden shield covered in hide. Hold it in a hand to block most of a blow.

scarab.name: Gold scarab
scarab.text: A beetle made of gold. Treasure.

rustic_knife.name: Rough knife
rustic_knife.text: A plain iron knife with a wooden grip. Someone made it by hand.

bone.name: Bone
bone.text: An old leg bone. It makes a poor club, and it will not last.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.text: A strip of old linen, torn from the dead. Wound round a cut, it heals a little.

jackal_hide.name: Jackal hide
jackal_hide.text: The black pelt of a jackal. Rough, and no use to you yet.

jawbone.name: Jawbone
jawbone.text: A lower jaw with a few teeth left in it.

potsherd.name: Piece of a pot
potsherd.text: A piece of a broken clay pot.

rag.name: Rotten cloth
rag.text: A scrap of old linen. It is falling apart.

cracked_jar.name: Cracked jar
cracked_jar.text: A clay jar with a crack down its side. It holds nothing.

pitted_sword.name: Pitted sword
pitted_sword.text: A curved bronze sword, eaten green and pitted with age. The edge is gone. A dealer in Cairo might give something for it.

corroded_dagger.name: Corroded dagger
corroded_dagger.text: A bronze dagger so corroded that the blade bends. Worth a little to a collector, if anything.

broken_spear.name: Broken spear
broken_spear.text: A spear snapped off short, its bronze point loose on the shaft. It will not take many blows. Old enough to sell.

red_bottle.name: Small bottle
red_bottle.text: A small glass bottle of dark red liquid. Drinking it heals you.

khopesh_bronze.name: Bronze khopesh
khopesh_bronze.text: A heavy sword bent like a sickle, its edge kept sharp. A king's weapon.

war_hammer.name: War hammer
war_hammer.text: An iron head on a long haft. It breaks bone and stone.

medjay_spear.name: Medjay spear
medjay_spear.text: A guard's long spear with a bronze head. It keeps things at a distance.

glass_blade.name: Blade of black glass
glass_blade.text: A long knife chipped from black volcanic glass. Very sharp, very quick.

lion_mace.name: Lion-headed mace
lion_mace.text: A mace whose head is a roaring lion of solid bronze. Slow, and terrible when it lands.

bronze_shield.name: Bronze shield
bronze_shield.text: A round shield faced with bronze. It turns most blows.

key_ptah_gold.name: Golden key
key_ptah_gold.text: A key of gold, the bow shaped like a scarab. It fits a lock in the tower of Ptah.

key_ptah_silver.name: Silver key
key_ptah_silver.text: A key of tarnished silver, the bow shaped like a scarab. It fits a lock in the tower of Ptah.

key_ptah_green.name: Green key
key_ptah_green.text: A key of green stone, the bow shaped like a scarab. It fits a lock in the tower of Ptah.

key_ptah_blue.name: Blue key
key_ptah_blue.text: A key of blue stone, the bow shaped like a scarab. It fits a lock in the tower of Ptah.

key_nut_sun.name: Sun key
key_nut_sun.text: A key of gold, the bow shaped like a scarab. It fits a lock in the White Tower of Horus.

key_nut_sky.name: Sky key
key_nut_sky.text: A key of pale turquoise stone, the bow shaped like a scarab. It fits a lock in the White Tower of Horus.

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.text: A fine black stone for putting an edge on a weapon. Use it with a weapon in your hand: the weapon goes up one level and hits harder. The stone is used up.

linen_armour.name: Linen armour
linen_armour.text: A soldier's coat of many layers of linen glued together, stiff as a board. Worn on your body, it takes a fifth of every blow.

scale_shirt.name: Bronze scale shirt
scale_shirt.text: A shirt of small bronze scales sewn on leather. Worn on your body, it takes a third of every blow. It is heavy.

bronze_helmet.name: Bronze helmet
bronze_helmet.text: A round helmet of beaten bronze with a leather lining. Worn on your head, it takes a tenth of every blow.

key_nut_moon.name: Moon key
key_nut_moon.text: A key of silver, the bow shaped like a scarab. It fits a lock in the White Tower of Horus.

relic_ptah.name: Lapis gem of Ptah
relic_ptah.text: A gem as big as a thumbnail, cut with the sign of Ptah. It was taken from that god's realm. It belongs in the great seal in the hall.

relic_nut.name: Sapphire of Horus
relic_nut.text: A gem as big as a thumbnail, cut with the sign of Horus. It was taken from that god's realm. It belongs in the great seal in the hall.

relic_thoth.name: Turquoise of Thoth
relic_thoth.text: A gem as big as a thumbnail, cut with the sign of Thoth. It was taken from that god's realm. It belongs in the great seal in the hall.

relic_sekhmet.name: Carnelian of Sekhmet
relic_sekhmet.text: A gem as big as a thumbnail, cut with the sign of Sekhmet. It was taken from that god's realm. It belongs in the great seal in the hall.

relic_anubis.name: Amethyst of Anubis
relic_anubis.text: A gem as big as a thumbnail, cut with the sign of Anubis. It was taken from that god's realm. It belongs in the great seal in the hall.

relic_osiris.text: A gem as big as a thumbnail, cut with the sign of Osiris. It was taken from that god's realm. It belongs in the great seal in the hall.

relic_sobek.name: Peridot of Sobek
relic_sobek.text: A gem as big as a thumbnail, cut with the sign of Sobek. It was taken from that god's realm. It belongs in the great seal in the hall.

relic_ra.text: A gem as big as a thumbnail, cut with the sign of Ra. It was taken from that god's realm. It belongs in the great seal in the hall.
